name: star-hept-pyr
comment: The PYRAMID probe on the 7-fold family. Same D=840 grid, but only {3}, {7/2}, {7/3}: a pyramid needs nothing else, and the full five-tile palette at maxValence 7 did not finish its k=2 solve in ten minutes. maxValence 7 is the point of this palette and NOT a speed dial — a pyramid over a 7-gon has seven triangles at its apex, so at the 6 every other palette here uses the apex is not in the alphabet at all and the solid cannot be found however long the search runs.
